Initial release of the elderly nighttime sleep abnormal event detection skill.

- Monitors and analyzes elderly nighttime sleep via infrared night vision camera and microphone.
- Detects key abnormal sleep events: sudden sitting-up, screams, and arm-thrashing.
- Records event time, frequency, duration, and generates structured sleep-abnormality event reports.
- Provides risk assessment, behavior mode classification, and family/caregiver-friendly summaries.
- Enables integration with smart-home cameras or elderly-care monitoring platforms.
- Strict open-id workflow for user identity and secure access to historical reports.
